anomalies.label: SOL–CENTAURI BEARING
anomalies.subtitle: Home System · Twin Golden Reference
anomalies.description: Ten light-years astern, Sol and Alpha Centauri burn steady in visible light. Calibrate the home-star reference to anchor your astrometric baseline across the quiet dark.

anomalies.label: CARINA RIFT NURSERY
anomalies.subtitle: Dust-Veiled Stellar Cliffs
anomalies.description: Opaque molecular dust hides this stellar nursery in visible light. Tune into mid-infrared to slice past the dark cliffs and shape the resonant emission wave emerging behind them.

anomalies.label: CLUSTER J1419-A
anomalies.subtitle: Deep-Field Lens & Horizon Edge
anomalies.description: A massive foreground galaxy cluster bends ancient starlight in near-infrared. Resolve the deep-field optics to strip away glare and uncover the impossibly straight edge behind it.

anomalies.label: PULSAR RIFT S-04
anomalies.subtitle: High-Energy Shock & Repeating Facet
anomalies.description: Violent ultraviolet and X-ray jets flare along Sector S-04. Sync your timing aperture to the spinning neutron star's synchrotron beam to expose the repeating boundary facet.

anomalies.label: ANTIPODAL POLE SEAM
anomalies.subtitle: 180° Dual-Epoch Horizon Check
anomalies.description: Directly opposite Cluster J1419-A across the sky, dispersive multi-band checks reveal synchronized boundary shifts faster than light could ever carry a signal.
